corroboration_note: The official Baidu Mobile Assistant listing and Tencent MyApp listing both report version 22.12.1.0. Baidu lists 2026-09-24; Tencent MyApp lists 2026-09-23. Use the Baidu date as primary and preserve the one-day listing discrepancy in provenance.
download_source: Tencent MyApp CDN URL provided by the current Baidu app listing flow
apk_md5_check: Matches the 32-hex package identifier in the official Tencent CDN filename.
limitations: The preset is the default emoji package embedded in the 2026-09-24 Android app build; this does not establish when each individual drawing was first created.
The app APK was not added to the repository. Only the compact nested preset archive, its package metadata, and original WebP assets are retained.
The CDN package hash was checked; no separate publisher certificate allowlist was available in the local project.
